notes: Implemented Phase 2 of mobile-bottom-sheet-review-followups plan: E2E test coverage for focus trap. Created 7 Playwright tests covering: focus on open (BS-FT-E2E-01), Tab cycling containment (BS-FT-E2E-02), Tab wrap last-to-first (BS-FT-E2E-03), Shift+Tab wrap first-to-last (BS-FT-E2E-04), dismissal focus return (BS-FT-E2E-05), tab switching focus containment (BS-FT-E2E-06), and swipe dismiss (BS-FT-E2E-07). All 7 E2E tests pass, all 44 existing unit tests pass (0 failures). Key discoveries: (1) Playwright's page.click() on backdrop fails due to z-index occlusion by bottom sheet — resolved with page.mouse.click() at coordinates above the sheet; (2) Escape key via page.keyboard.press() unreliable with Vue's @keydown.escape.window.prevent in headless mode — unit test BS-FT-13 covers closeSidebars() directly; (3) Index-based element targeting required for focus wrap tests since many focusable elements (remove buttons) lack IDs; (4) Touch event simulation via plain Event + Object.defineProperty works because Vue handler only reads .touches[0].clientY without instanceof checks. World-review addressed: strengthened BS-FT-E2E-04 assertion with index verification, added clarifying comments for touch event simulation approach. N-3/N-4 documented as no-action-needed (existing test files already comprehensive).
